stories.intent: Annual audit findings raised and remediation plans created.

body.name: Annual Audit FY2026 — Scope: Finance, People, Procurement, Security, Projects, Contracts, Assets, Compliance. Samples: 25 expenses, 15 POs, 10 payroll, 12 access changes, 8 invoices, 5 contracts, 10 project changes.

body.title: Expense Approval Timestamps After Reimbursement Batch Generation
body.description: Some expense approval timestamps occurred after reimbursement batch generation. Root cause: Batch scheduling not gated on approval completion. Action: Block reimbursement batch unless all claims fully approved. Owner: Finance.

body.title: Two Old Project Service Accounts Have No Documented Owner
body.description: Two legacy project service accounts lack documented ownership. Action: Assign owners or decommission. Owner: Security.

body.title: One Vendor Risk Review Expired
body.description: Vendor risk review for one hardware vendor expired. Action: Complete review or update vendor status. Owner: Procurement.

expectedState: Remediation owners assigned with due dates

stories.intent: Year-end accounting close — FY2025-26 closed.

body.description: Year-end close exception — Contractor cost ₹1.2L in Project ERP but only ₹0.9L in Finance. Accrual posted for ₹30K difference. Final timesheet approved but accrual missed.
Annual fixed asset depreciation FY2026 — Laptops (3-year straight line), Monitors (5-year), Network equipment (3-year). Disposed assets excluded.
Revenue cut-off adjustment — Invoice issued 30-Mar but milestone accepted 04-Apr. Revenue deferred to FY2027 under configured policy. Unbilled revenue for March work recognized.

stories.intent: OKR final scoring — company objectives assessed.

body.title: FY2026 OKR Final Scores — Company Overall 87%
body.justification: O1 Revenue 86% (₹1.08Cr of ₹1.25Cr), O2 Delivery 88% (SLA 96%), O3 Team 91% (Utilization 74%, Learning 86%), O4 Sales 82% (pipeline good, win rate improving). Company overall: 87%. Headcount intentionally MISS (38 vs 50 target) — strategy shift to profitability.

expectedState: Headcount MISS intentional — profitability over scale

stories.intent: Year-1 final reconciliation — comprehensive cross-ERP verification.
